capability.summary: Resolve a DNS record through Google DoH
capability.description: Queries Google Public DNS-over-HTTPS for required name and optional record type, defaulting type to A. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: DNS record resolution; not domain ownership verification, website availability testing, or network intrusion.

constraint.io_signature: Input: name at CLI position 1 and optional type at position 2. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and Google DNS result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional DNS record type string; default is A
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://dns.google/resolve with name=<name> and type=<type or A>
no DNSSEC, CD, DO, ECS, padding, response-format, pagination, or resolver-selection input
wrapper does not locally truncate or interpret Answer/Status fields
DNS answers are time-sensitive and resolver-dependent; no auth, cache, or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Google DNS status and answer records, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: query Google Public DNS over HTTPS
negative_intents: scan a host or diagnose a network intrusion

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Google DNS status and answer records, URL, and HTTP status.
